baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural imperative ذوقوا governs both عذابي and نذر, joining punishment and warning under one sensory verb.
baseline_models.mechanism: Oral sampling expands into firsthand ordeal: punitive pain becomes the experienced referent that confirms the prior alarm, so message and outcome are no longer separable.

activation_trace.role: Oral tasting supplies the sensory frame through which the whole command is received.
Firsthand ordeal extends tasting into experiential verification of what was announced.
Severe punitive pain supplies the reality that the addressees must experience.
An alarm meant to awaken caution supplies the message now verified by its outcome.

changed_reading.before: Receive punishment after having received warnings.
changed_reading.after: Experience the punishment as firsthand confirmation of the warning itself.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذوقوا can activate a becoming-condition branch, with عذابي as the condition and نذر as its announced threshold.
baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative can mark a crossing from anticipation into a new condition: warning stands before the threshold, while punishment is the state entered when announcement becomes actuality.

activation_trace.role: Becoming a condition after separation supplies a state-transition image for tasting.
Punitive suffering supplies the destination state rather than a merely sampled object.
Advance alarm supplies the threshold that precedes entry into the announced condition.

changed_reading.before: Briefly sample the punishment that was warned about.
changed_reading.after: Cross into the punitive condition that the warning had held ahead of you.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial and disputation keep warning in contestable speech; the tasting imperative ends that distance by making its truth bodily and nondelegable.

activation_trace.role: Firsthand ordeal supplies the experiential proof that replaces verbal distance.
The cautioning alarm supplies the proposition whose truth is forced into experience.
Contradicting truth supplies the initial refusal that tasting reverses.
Disputatious denial supplies the failed verbal mode displaced by bodily encounter.

structural_cues: 54:33 opens with denial of the warnings, and 54:36 repeats warning, disputation, and warnings before the focus.
The focus clause first occurs at the end of 54:37, after dispute has become an event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial and dispute before tasting; I infer a change of epistemic medium from argument to embodied proof. A live alternative is retribution with no epistemic function.

changed_reading.before: Taste the penalty that follows rejected warnings.
changed_reading.after: Taste direct proof of what denial and disputation kept at the level of words.

context_deltas.mechanism: A marked morning onset plus fixedness activates the becoming-state branch of ذوق: tasting is the threshold into punishment that has settled, not a transient sample.

activation_trace.role: Becoming a condition supplies the transition from first contact to sustained state.
Punitive pain supplies the state whose onset and persistence the context specifies.
Arrival in the morning supplies a marked temporal onset for the transition.
Fixity and settlement supply duration beyond the first taste.

structural_cues: 54:38 immediately precedes the focus and predicates punishment as settled.
The command already occurred in 54:37, then recurs after duration has been specified.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies morning arrival and settled punishment; I infer an onset-to-state transition. A live alternative is that settled describes duration while tasting remains momentary.

changed_reading.before: Take a momentary sample of punishment.
changed_reading.after: Cross at its onset into the already announced punishment as an enduring condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Experiential tasting is followed immediately by ease and remembrance; punishment becomes a bodily mnemonic whose consequence reopens recall after warning was ignored.

activation_trace.role: Firsthand ordeal supplies a bodily inscription that can resist later forgetting.
The cautioning alarm supplies the content that the punitive experience makes memorable.
Opening into ease after difficulty supplies renewed access to the lesson.
A reminder that prompts recollection supplies the pedagogical function of the encounter.

structural_cues: 54:40 immediately follows the focus with the ease-for-remembrance question.
The focus coordinates punishment and warning before that question, keeping remembered content attached to consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies experiential tasting followed by facilitated remembrance; I infer that consequence functions as an anti-forgetting device. A live alternative is that 54:40 is only a compositional refrain.

changed_reading.before: Punishment confirms a warning after memory has failed.
changed_reading.after: The confirmation also forces remembrance: the body carries the warning that memory evaded.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning behaves like notice of an enforceable claim: recompense can be collected, seizure executes it, and the later question asks whether a written release exists.

activation_trace.role: A wound carrying an obligatory assessment supplies the liability image for warning.
Punitive pain supplies execution of the liability rather than mere notification.
Collection and satisfaction of a debt supply the due becoming payable.
Taking to account for guilt supplies the enforcement step.
Release from a claim supplies the exemption whose existence is questioned.
Writing and book supply the documentary location imagined for that exemption.

structural_cues: 54:35 names recompense before the warning and punishment sequence.
54:42-43 move from seizure to a question about immunity in writings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense, culpable seizure, release, and writing; I infer a notice-to-liability-to-collection arrow. A live alternative is ordinary recompense plus a rhetorical question, with no legal mechanism.

changed_reading.after: My warnings operate as notices of liability whose announced due is collected in the punishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The bow-testing branch of taste activates against a voiced claim of gathered, aided strength; the next ayah breaks the rank, so punishment loads the claim until its capacity is exposed.

activation_trace.role: Testing a bow under tension supplies the stress-test analogy for tasting.
Voiced speech supplies the claim placed under test.
Gathered strength supplies the claimed load-bearing capacity.
Aid and manifested support supply the expected protection.
Breaking and repelling a battle rank supply the observed failure under load.

structural_cues: 54:44 voices a collective claim of victory, and 54:45 immediately predicts the collective's defeat.
The focus plural addresses a collective while taste remains an embodied test.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a testing branch, a strength claim, and a broken rank; I infer that punishment functions as the load that falsifies the claim. A live alternative is a military sequence with no test analogy.

changed_reading.before: A group is ordered to suffer.
changed_reading.after: The group is put under load, and its claim of collective invulnerability is experimentally falsified.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because the ع ذ ب inventory places palatable sweetness beside punishment; valid because ذوقوا supplies tasting and the punitive branch preserves the noun's controlling force; render only as ironic root-image resonance, never as a claim that عذاب means sweetness here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The taste imperative at word 1 and the ع ذ ب noun at word 2.

activation_trace.role: Oral tasting supplies the flavor frame that permits an ironic reversal.
Sweet and palatable intake supplies the positive pole reversed by punishment.
Severe punitive pain keeps the actual noun anchored in its ordinary force.

changed_reading.after: Taste punishment as the bitter reversal of what had seemed palatable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it activates a rare uncovered-to-sky branch of ع ذ ب; valid because the focus noun carries that branch while 54:34 supplies wind-driven assault and rescue by separation; render as a spatial and material overlay, not a lexical gloss of عذابي.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عذابي at focus word 2, with tasting making exposure bodily.

activation_trace.role: Being uncovered beneath the sky supplies exposed vertical geometry to the punishment.
A wind that drives hard matter supplies the assault meeting that exposure.
Rescue through separation supplies the contrasting removal of one party from exposure.

changed_reading.after: Punishment is bodily exposure after sheltering separation: one party is removed while another meets the wind-driven assault.

strongest_changes: Denial and disputation become firsthand proof when the warning is tasted as its outcome.
The preceding settled punishment turns tasting from a sample into entry into a durable state.
The following remembrance refrain makes punishment an embodied anti-forgetting device.
Later claims of collective victory place the tasting command under a social stress-test.
summary.what_was_special: One imperative governs both punishment and warnings, allowing sensory, temporal, mnemonic, legal, and stress-test readings without detaching from the three focus roots.
remaining_uncertainties: The state-entry force depends on a distant ذ و ق branch and may be only contextual resonance.
The legal and bow-testing models are functional analogies, not lexical replacements.
The sweetness and exposure outliers should remain qualified branch echoes.
